thread:
Theo: morning handoff — I'm primary until 18:00 UTC, Priya is secondary. Leaving notes below for anyone taking over.

Priya: noted. I'll be reachable on Slack and phone (mobile +1-555-0123) — covering late overlap 17:30-19:00 UTC.

Theo: quick summary of current state: no active SEV. Dedicated pool utilization steady (~62%), latency p95 for text-gen routes at 170ms. We still have the occasional cache-miss spike on the eu-west nodes; see runbook pointer.

Sam: thanks. Can you paste the runbook link? Also remind me the exact paging rules for SEV1 vs SEV2.

Theo: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-outage (perm: eng+oncall). Paging rules (short):
- SEV1 (cluster-wide availability or >30% customer-impacting errors): page primary immediately, then secondary if no ack in 3 minutes. If not resolved in 10 minutes escalate to on-call lead (Lee) + Eng Director (pagerduty).
- SEV2 (degraded latency impacting multiple customers): page primary, notify secondary; escalate after 15 minutes if no progress.
- SEV3 (single-customer issues / low impact): create ticket, notify owner, no immediate page unless customer requests pager escalation.

Priya: small tweak from last retro: ack window for SEV1 is 3 minutes but if primary is in a scheduled meeting we allow a 5 minute grace before auto-escalation. Documented under the handoff checklist.

oncall-bot: [automated note] incident-bot: new alertgroup "inference-kvcache-eu" fired 1m ago. Severity candidate: medium. Link: https://incidents.redwood/alerts/ig-8734

Theo: saw that. I checked metrics: KV cache miss rate briefly hit 12% on eu-west-2 for ~90s, ingress spiky but no 5xxs. Treat as SEV2 candidate. Priya, can you take initial triage?

Priya: on it. Steps I'm doing now:
1) Check health endpoints for eu-west instances (healthz).
2) Restart proxy pod if any 503s.
3) Verify prefix cache hits from grafana dashboard: dash/realtime/cache
4) If still elevated, failover traffic to fallback-model-route for affected customers using routing policy ID rp-eu-01.

Sam: re escalation matrix, add that after 15 minutes of active debugging with no progress for SEV1 we should call the SRE paging list and the on-call lead joins bridge. For SEV2, a 30-minute judgement window unless customer impact increases.

Lee: adding availability note — if primary + secondary are both unreachable (rare), PagerDuty auto-escalation covers to the SRE rota. Phone tree: pagerduty -> oncall lead -> eng director. PD rules live here: https://internal.redwood/pagerduty/rules

Priya: triage update: health endpoints good, no 503s in the last 2m, cache miss spike seems correlated to a single model rollout at 17:45 UTC. Rolling back that canary would be my first mitigation. Requesting canary rollback now.

Theo: good call. If rollback is needed: follow runbook step 3. Command we use:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-service model=model:vX.Y.Z --record
# or use console rollback: Console > Deployments > model-service > Rollback
```
When rolling back, notify support@redwood so CS can message affected customers.

oncall-bot: [automated] pagerduty incident: none created. Alert downgraded to INFO after 4m.

Priya: rollback applied, canary removed, miss rate falling back to baseline (~2%). I'll monitor for 30m and update.

Sam: for handoffs going forward, suggested checklist (to include in handoff messages):
- Current primary/secondary + timezone windows
- Active alerts list + links
- Any running rollouts or feature flags
- Paging rules summary (SEV mapping + ack windows)
- Contact list (phone + PD links)
- Runbook quick links (inference, networking, routing)

Theo: nice. Let's make that a template in the runbooks page. Also quick note on escalation language to PD messages: include cause hypothesis + mitigation attempted + expected ETA. PD templates:
```
SEV1: "Inference cluster outage — high error rate across regions. Hypothesis: autoscaler bug after kernel update. Mitigations: scaled down canaries, rolled back model vX.Y.Z. ETA: 15m."
```

Lee: one more operational rule: if an external customer-facing incident is declared, product comms should be looped in within 10 minutes. Use the #customer-impact channel and ping @product-ops.

Priya: monitoring note: I'll create a follow-up ticket to add an explicit alert that triggers earlier for KV cache miss delta > 5% over 60s. Ticket created: INC-4521 (link: https://tracker.redwood/INC-4521).

Sam: closing notes for this handoff — primary: Priya until 19:00 UTC, secondary: Theo (on-call backup), on-call lead: Lee. No outstanding SEVs. Priya will post a final "handoff clear" message when she signs off.

Priya: handoff clear — leaving monitoring on; page me if anything crosses SEV2 threshold. Signing off at 19:00 UTC.

pagerduty: [system] reminder: please ensure your contact info is up to date in PagerDuty settings to avoid missed escalations.

Theo: thanks team, good handoff. I'll pick up overnight checks and keep the runbook updates in the docs.
